name: MW 2019 Music Pack
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

Mod adds the music/ost from Modern Warfare 2019 to SPT.

Install instructions: You know how to install. Drag BepinEx folder to SPT Directory

Updated to SPT 3.10.X

Credit goes to infinity Ward for the game and artists for OST

Preview: https://youtu.be/Djq2cqJRMh0?si=UszUx2ibDIXNcKGX (don’t remember this ever playing maybe it was in a trailer)

finally updated to SPT 3.11 version have fun!
